name: Carbon tax (carbon component of Mineral Oil Tax) on auto-diesel
law: Finance Act 1999 Schedule 2A, as Revenue's Excise Duty Rates manual gives it: the carbon component of Mineral Oil Tax on heavy oil used as a propellant (auto-diesel) charges 71.00 euro per tonne of CO2 its burning emits. Fuel suppliers pay it with the Mineral Oil Tax and pass it on in the fuel price.

sources.title: Revenue (Ireland): energy excise duty rates, Mineral Oil Tax with its carbon component and the amount charged per tonne of CO2, with previous rates
